column1: ## Repository Table R21. Model checkpoint and alignment provenance

## Description: Resolved checkpoint and alignment identifiers. Licence entries describe the retained source metadata, not legal authorization to redistribute controlled-cohort derivatives. Missing revisions are explicitly unavailable. Bibliographic architecture summaries are in Supplementary Table S3.
## Missing values: NA means unavailable or not applicable, never a zero score. Numeric values retain source precision.
## Column 1 | Model | Evaluated checkpoint display name, harmonized with the figures.
## Column 2 | Checkpoint | Checkpoint for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 3 | Model revision | Model revision for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 4 | Tokenizer revision | Tokenizer revision for the observation defined in the table description.
